card.name: Section 2 dosage heading numbering
card.fires_on: Numbers and spaces inside the section 2 numbering of drug-label dosage sections. It fires on the digit after "2." in subsection numbers like 2.3 or 2.4, and on the space right after the "2 DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION" heading.

modes.label: Subsection digit
modes.description: The digit or dot in a 2.x subsection number such as 2.3 or 2.4 that starts a dosage subsection.
modes.example: 2.<<3>> Patient Preparation Instruct patients to drink water

modes.label: After the heading
modes.description: The space right after the "2 DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION" heading, just before the first dose text.
modes.example: 2 DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION<< >>120 mg orally once daily.

card.plain: It marks the spot where the Dosage and Administration section begins or moves to a new numbered subsection in a drug label.
